title: Variable-Tape Self-Description Startup
statement: For every natural number $k$ and every effective code system $E$ assigning each binary string $\alpha$ a deterministic binary machine with $k$ work tapes and a finite indexed state set, there are a natural number $K$, a finite state set $P$, a deterministic binary machine $R$ with $K+(k+2)$ work tapes, and an exit state in $P$ such that the following holds. For each $\alpha$, there are natural numbers $T$ and $B$ so that, for every binary input $w$, after exactly $T$ steps on $\langle\alpha,w\rangle$, $R$ is in the exit state, its input-head position is $1$, all work-head positions are $0$, and its output is empty; work tape $k$ stores the decoded machine's transition table, work tape $k+1$ stores its unary initial-state encoding shifted by two cells, and every other work-tape cell is blank. The exit state is not reached at any earlier time, the output remains empty through time $T$, and the total space used by time $T$ is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ assigns each binary string $\alpha$ a machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$ for some $n$
$E$ has a canonizer computing the serialized machine within its stated time bound
$P$ is finite and has decidable equality
$T$ and $B$ are natural numbers depending on $\alpha$
replaced:
For every natural number $k$ and every effective code system assigning each binary
string $\alpha$ a $k$-work-tape binary machine with finitely many indexed states, there
exist a natural number $K$, a finite state set $P$, a deterministic binary machine $R$
with $K+k+2$ work tapes, and an exit state. For each $\alpha$, there are natural numbers
$T$ and $B$ such that, on every binary input $w$, after exactly $T$ steps on
$\langle\alpha,w\rangle$, the machine is in the exit state with input-head position $1$,
empty output, and all work-head positions zero; work tape $k$ stores the decoded
machine's transition table, tape $k+1$ stores its unary initial-state encoding shifted
by two cells, and every other tape is blank. The exit state is not reached earlier, the
output remains empty through time $T$, and the total space used by time $T$ is at most
$B$.
